Madison County, Virginia Tax Sales: Your Simple Guide to Buying Property at Auction

Madison County, Virginia runs tax sales when property owners fall behind on their taxes. These public auctions give buyers a chance to purchase real estate while helping the county recover unpaid taxes. If you’re thinking about jumping in, this guide will help you understand the process clearly.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Madison County Holds Tax Sales

The county doesn’t follow a yearly schedule. Sales are held only when there are tax-delinquent properties.

  • Frequency: As needed
  • How to Stay Informed: Watch for public notices and check our Auction Calendar

What Time the Auction Starts

Every auction has its time listed in the public notice.

  • Typical Start Time: Varies with each auction
  • How to Confirm: Check the auction announcement early

Do You Need to Register to Bid?

Yes, registration is a must.

  • Who Can Register: Anyone interested in bidding
  • When to Register:
    • Opens when the auction is posted
    • Ends before the auction day (deadline listed in the notice)

Where Auctions Take Place

Most auctions are held at a public location listed in the sale notice.

  • Common Location: Madison County Courthouse
  • How to Know for Sure: Check the official sale announcement

Can the Property Be Redeemed Before the Sale?

Yes—but only before the auction takes place.

  • Before Auction: Property owners can pay all dues to cancel the sale
  • After Auction: The right to redeem is gone

How the Bidding and Payment Process Works

If you win, there are a few steps to follow.

  • Highest Bid Wins: Simple and straightforward
  • Deposit Requirement:
    • Must be paid immediately after the sale
    • Amount is mentioned in the auction terms
  • Buyer’s Premium:
    • An extra fee may be added to your final bid
  • Payment Deadline & Methods:
    • Listed in the auction notice
    • Usually includes certified checks or money orders
  • Deed Type: Special Warranty Deed (limited guarantees)

Where to Get Auction Info and Listings

You can find updates and new sale announcements on:

  • Madison County Treasurer’s Office Website
  • Auction Calendar (Check often for updates)

Contact Info for Questions

Have a question or need help?

  • Madison County Treasurer’s Office
  • Email: smurray@madisonco.virginia.gov
  • Phone: (540) 948-4409

Smart Tips Before You Bid

Keep these in mind for a smoother experience:

  • Explore properties near Shenandoah trail access—they often fly under the radar.
  • Create your own tracking sheet; the county’s records can sometimes be challenging to navigate.
  • Don’t overlook extra costs such as attorney fees and recording expenses; these aren’t rolled into the bid.
